summary.overpaid: Overpaid to sellers: {{amount}} — it will be deducted from future markups

fields.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one

form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters: lowercase, uppercase and a digit. Tap the dice to generate one.
form.editPasswordHint: Better not change it here: “Reset password” on the seller page creates a new one and shows it.

balance.title: Balance
balance.footer: Earned − refunds − payouts. Every line is in the feed below, so the total always adds up.
balance.overpaidHint: Paid out more than earned (for example, after a refund). It will be deducted from the next markups.
balance.pendingCaption: {{amount}} of it is in debts that are not paid yet
balance.pendingInDebtsHint: The markup is recorded, but the customer has not paid yet

feed.title: Balance feed
feed.reverseHint: Paid out by mistake? Tap the payout to cancel it.

payout.title: Pay the seller
payout.hint: You can pay all or part — the rest keeps accumulating. A mistake can be cancelled in the feed.

reverse.title: Cancel payout
reverse.text: The payout of {{amount}} to {{name}} will be cancelled and the amount returns to “To pay out”. The record stays in the feed.
reverse.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. paid to the wrong person

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.text: Create a new password for {{name}}? The old one will stop working.
resetPassword.hint: The password is shown once — pass it to the seller right away. If they are in the app right now, it may keep working for up to 15 minutes.
resetPassword.once: The password is visible only now. Once you close this window you cannot see it again — you would have to reset it once more.
resetPassword.copyFailed: Could not copy — write the password down manually

access.title: Access
access.deactivateText: They will no longer be able to sign in. Sales, debts and balance stay — you can still pay them out. You can enable them back at any time.
access.footer: A seller can be deleted only while they have no sales and payouts.
access.footerWithHistory: Cannot delete — there are sales or payouts. Disable instead: history and balance are kept.
access.footerDisabled: Disabled {{date}}. Cannot sign in, history is kept.

actions.areYouSure: Are you sure you want to delete this seller?
